subject.title: feat(agents): add scoped command prompt projection

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this command projection and the new public plugin CLI metadata contract as a core agent-prompt surface?
rationale: The PR adds new model-facing behavior and three external plugin descriptor fields with default public exposure semantics; repository history and tests cannot determine the permanent product and compatibility contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow typed projection
options.body: Approve a smaller projection using exact tool-call arguments, constrained dynamic literals, explicit plugin opt-in, and real-run proof.

options.title: Defer prompt consumer
options.body: Review the command inventory foundation separately and postpone model-facing projection until a concrete trusted caller is sponsored.

options.title: Accept broader contract
options.body: Own the proposed prompt and plugin API surface after documenting compatibility, disclosure, and paired-node trust expectations.

recommendation.title: Narrow typed projection
recommendation.body: Approve a smaller projection using exact tool-call arguments, constrained dynamic literals, explicit plugin opt-in, and real-run proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history shows direct ownership of the agent system-prompt and provider prompt-contribution boundaries affected here.
